verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁੱਘੂ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਵਸਦੀ ਛਡਿ ਰਹੈ ਓਜਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: ghu'ghoo sujh na sujhiee vasadhee chhadd rahai ojaaRee|

en.bdb: Owl does not have any thoughtful understanding and leaving habitats lives in deserted places.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਲਿ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਨਾ ਪੜ੍ਹੈ ਚੂਹੇ ਖਾਇ ਉਡੇ ਦੇਹਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: eil paRhaiee naa paRhai choohe khai udde dhehaaRee|

en.bdb: Kite cannot be taught texts and eating rats keeps on flying the whole day.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਂਸ ਨੋ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਚੰਦਣ ਵਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: vaas na aavai vaa(n)s no haumai ag na cha(n)dhan vaaRee|

en.bdb: Even being in the garden of sandal wood, the egotist bamboo does not get fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੀਣਾ ਦੇਹ ਵਿਗਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhahu sakhanaa gurmat heenaa dheh vigaaRee|

en.bdb: As the conch remains empty though liviing in sea, the person devoid of the wisdom of Guru (gurmati) is spoiling his body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਪ ਗਣਾਏ ਵਡਾ ਅਨਾੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: si(n)mal birakh na safal hoi aap ganaae vaddaa anaaRee|

en.bdb: The cotton-silk tree does not bear fruit howsoever much that colourless may brag of its greatness.
